g.title: TLS_QSP
g.text: Tumour Lysis Syndrome — Quantitative Systems Pharmacology Map
release flux vs clearance capacity, closed into a loop through the kidney
(22 clusters · 211 nodes · 320 edges · therapy nodes coloured by operator class)

g.title: cluster_trigger
g.text: 1. Cytoreductive trigger (the release rate is a PRESCRIPTION variable)

g.title: cluster_release
g.text: 2. Cell death and intracellular content release

g.title: cluster_xoi
g.text: 4. Xanthine oxidase inhibitors — FLUX operators (block production, cannot empty a pool)

g.title: cluster_uox
g.text: 5. Urate oxidase — POOL operator (destroys existing solute; zero-order at TLS concentrations)

g.title: cluster_uahandle
g.text: 6. Renal urate handling — the kidney's only defence is a saturable one

g.title: cluster_uaxtal
g.text: 7. Urate speciation and crystallisation — where the two threshold concentrations live

g.title: cluster_xanxtal
g.text: 8. The substitution the flux operator makes: xanthine

g.title: cluster_k
g.text: 9. Potassium — the solute on the knife edge (flux/capacity ratio 0.4 at intact GFR)

g.title: cluster_cardiac
g.text: 10. Cardiac electrophysiology — the endpoint that kills within minutes

g.title: cluster_po4
g.text: 11. Phosphate — winnable at intact GFR (ratio 0.5), lost once the urate limb takes the GFR

g.title: cluster_ca
g.text: 12. Calcium — a readout of the precipitation, not an independent abnormality

g.title: cluster_cap
g.text: 13. Calcium-phosphate precipitation — the second crystal, and the one alkali makes worse

g.title: cluster_injury
g.text: 14. Tubular injury — crystal-dependent and crystal-independent limbs

g.title: cluster_gfr
g.text: 15. GFR — the term that closes the loop

g.title: cluster_fluid
g.text: 16. Fluid therapy — DILUTION operator (raises UA_crit without touching any pool or flux)

g.title: cluster_alk
g.text: 17. Alkalinisation — SPECIATION operator with a two-sided price

g.title: cluster_rrt
g.text: 18. Renal replacement therapy — the only POOL operator for K⁺ and phosphate

g.title: cluster_crs
g.text: 19. Overlap and differential — cytokine release syndrome

g.title: cluster_measure
g.text: 22. Measurement layer — what the numbers on the chart actually are

g.title: cluster_legend
g.text: Operator classes (a therapy in one class cannot substitute for another)
